title: Weymouth New Testament in Modern Speech, 2 Peter
summary: "Weymouth New Testament in Modern Speech, 2 Peter" by Richard Francis Weymouth is a Bible translation published in 1903. Weymouth sought to express how the New Testament's inspired writers would have described events if writing in nineteenth-century English. Based on his compilation of major Greek texts, this translation aimed to serve as a concise commentary alongside traditional versions.
